palette.primary_role: 主色 — 蓝色系：信任、沉稳、可靠。软蓝到深蓝的梯级，避免过于临床/医疗感
palette.accent_role: 强调色 — 绿色(生命力/自然) + 暖橙(温暖/活力)，用于CTA和重点标记
palette.surface_role: 背景色 — 暖白/奶油色为主，避免纯白(过于临床)；辅以柔蓝/青灰交替区分section
palette.neutral_role: 正文颜色 — 深灰而非纯黑，柔和且对比度充足(≥4.5:1)，适合老年用户阅读
palette.border_role: 边框颜色 — 浅灰/灰绿，轻微存在感，不抢内容焦点

h1.notes: APFM 72px/400, Sunrise 52px/325(light), Brookdale 44px/400. Range reflects hero vs. section heading.

h2.notes: APFM 56px, Sunrise 55px, Brookdale 44px. Large, confident headings for scannability.

h3.notes: APFM 18px, Sunrise 14px(small!), Brookdale 30px. Wide variation; 20-24px recommended for accessibility.

body.notes: CRITICAL: 14px(APFM) is common industry baseline but 16px minimum recommended for senior audience. Brookdale/Sunrise use 16px. Ideal range 16-18px for body, 16-20px for CTAs.

small.notes: Captions, legal text. Never below 14px for accessibility.

line_height.notes: Sunrise: 24px(=1.5), APFM: 21px(=1.5), Brookdale: 20.8px(=1.3). Generous line-height aids readability for older eyes.

section_padding.notes: Sunrise uses 40px and 100px section padding. APFM hero has 80px padding.

content_max_width.notes: Sunrise max 1600px (very wide). Most use 1140-1200px. Senior care sites tend toward wider layouts for larger type.

border_radius.buttons_role: APFM uses pill-shaped (9999px) secondary buttons for friendly feel; Brookdale uses 4px conventional; Sunrise uses 0px (flat)
border_radius.cards_role: Flat to subtly rounded. Brookdale cards have 0px radius with shadow.
border_radius.inputs_role: Search inputs and forms typically use moderate rounding

elevation.shadows: Subtle, warm shadows. Never harsh or dramatic.
elevation.notes: Brookdale uses a soft offset shadow with negative spread for subtle depth. Sunrise uses flat design (no shadow). Shadows should evoke warmth, not drama.

typical_order: header (warm bg: cream/white, logo left, prominent phone number with tel: link, 'Schedule a Tour' / 'Find a Community' primary CTA, hamburger or minimal nav)
hero (large warm photo of seniors + family, headline about care/dignity/peace of mind, search bar or location finder as primary interaction, phone number visible)
care types overview (icon+title+description cards: Independent Living / Assisted Living / Memory Care / Respite Care)
location finder / community search (zip code or city input, map or list results)
how it works / process steps (numbered steps with illustrations, reassuring copy about the journey)
amenities & lifestyle (photo-rich: dining, activities, gardens, social events, wellness programs)
testimonials / reviews (family quotes, resident stories, star ratings, video testimonials optional)
safety & health protocols (clinical but warm: staff credentials, medication management, emergency response, COVID-19 info)
cost calculator / financial guidance (interactive tool or clear pricing tiers, insurance guidance)
about / mission statement (company story, years in operation, core values, leadership photos)
CTA footer section (get started, call now, schedule tour — urgent but warm)
footer (location links by state, care types, about, careers, contact, phone, social media)
hero_variants: large photo + headline overlay + CTA button (Sunrise style: 52px white headline, 'Book a Tour' btn)
photo + search bar + headline (APFM style: 'Find senior living near you' 72px + pill-shaped search tabs)
photo + value prop + CTA (Brookdale style: photo + 'Brookdale Senior Living' 44px + 'Search Now' green btn)
card_variants: care type cards (icon + title + short description, 3-4 across, soft bg or white with shadow)
location cards (photo + community name + address + phone + 'Learn More' link)
amenity cards (photo-dominant, title overlay, lifestyle imagery: dining, garden, activity)

interaction_patterns.phone_visibility: Always visible in header (large, colored, with icon). Multiple tel: links throughout page.
interaction_patterns.form_style: Short (2-3 fields), reassuring microcopy, large input fields, clear labels
interaction_patterns.trust_badges: Awards, certifications, years in business, partner logos (often in hero or footer area)

tone_profile.headline_style: Reassuring and family-oriented. Emphasize peace of mind, dignity, and living fully. APFM: 'Find senior living near you' (direct, helpful). Sunrise: 'Senior Living That Helps You Live Fully' (aspirational). Brookdale: 'Brookdale Senior Living' (established, trusted).
tone_profile.cta_style: Action-oriented but gentle. 'Schedule a Tour', 'Find a Community', 'Search Now', 'Book a Tour', 'Talk to an Advisor'. Never aggressive or salesy. Warm invitation, not hard sell.
trust_signals: Family testimonials with full names and photos
Years in business / number of communities
anti_patterns: Don't use tiny fonts — 16px minimum for body, 14px absolute minimum
Don't use dark/moody color schemes — avoid black, charcoal heavy designs
Don't use institutional/sterile imagery — no empty hallways, medical equipment closeups
Don't use aggressive sales tactics — no countdown timers, 'limited spots', urgency popups
Don't use pure white (#FFFFFF) as dominant background — use cream/off-white for warmth
Don't hide phone numbers — they must be prominent and tappable on mobile

color_mood.name: warm earthy
color_mood.description: APFM-inspired: warm cream + periwinkle blue + amber. Most popular, universally appealing.

color_mood.name: soft coastal
color_mood.description: Sunrise-inspired: teal blue + warm orange + soft gray-blue. Fresh, modern, energizing.

color_mood.name: classic traditional
color_mood.description: Brookdale-inspired: navy blue + leaf green + warm white. Established, trustworthy, conventional.

typography_mood.name: serif traditional
typography_mood.heading: Optima / Commissioner (APFM custom fonts)
typography_mood.description: Mix of serif heading + sans body for classic warmth. APFM uses Commissioner (bold serif) for headings with self-hosted fonts.

typography_mood.name: sans-serif accessible
typography_mood.heading: Montserrat / Gotham
typography_mood.description: Clean sans-serif throughout for maximum readability. Sunrise uses Gotham + Montserrat. Brookdale uses Montserrat throughout.

typography_mood.name: humanist modern
typography_mood.heading: Poppins
typography_mood.description: Single typeface family for cohesion. Warm geometric sans that reads as friendly and contemporary.

layout_density.name: spacious and airy
layout_density.description: Sunrise-inspired. Wide layouts, generous whitespace, large hero images. Feels premium and calm.

layout_density.name: moderate density with more CTAs
layout_density.description: APFM-inspired. Balanced content density, multiple CTAs per page, search-focused interaction.

critical: Body text minimum 16px — this is a MEDICAL NECESSITY for senior audience, not just a design preference
Color contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for all text, 3:1 for large text (18px+) — WCAG AA
Phone numbers must be large, tappable tel: links with minimum 44x44px touch target
Form inputs must have clear visible labels (not placeholder-only), large touch targets
Avoid low-contrast gray text on light backgrounds — common anti-pattern
Navigation must be simple — this audience is less tech-savvy; hamburger menus should be obvious
No auto-playing video/audio — can disorient older users
Focus states must be clearly visible for keyboard navigation
recommended: Line height 1.5 minimum for body text — improves readability for aging eyes
Sans-serif fonts preferred for screen readability (Montserrat, Poppins, Open Sans)
Avoid italics for body text — harder to read at smaller sizes
Use generous letter-spacing (0.01-0.02em) for improved character recognition
Consider a font-size toggle widget (small/medium/large) for user preference

a_place_for_mom.differentiator: Lead generation marketplace (not a community operator). Search-first UX. Blue color signals tech/trust. Pill-shaped buttons are distinctive. 14px body is smaller than competitors — potential accessibility concern.

sunrise_senior_living.differentiator: Premium community operator. Light H1 weight (325) is unique — feels airy/aspirational. Teal + orange palette is modern and distinctive. Flat design (no shadows, 0px radius). Photo-heavy with warm lifestyle imagery.

brookdale.differentiator: Largest operator, established brand. Green accent signals health/nature. Most conventional design language. Rounded buttons (4px). Cards with depth via shadow. Strong Montserrat typeface consistency.

atria_senior_living.differentiator: Modular design system across sub-brands. Known for portrait-forward photography (residents + staff). Scannable layout for amenities/pricing. Accessibility-first type sizing.
